text:
jamie: Quick post-launch note: several small but visible issues have bubbled up during the pilot demos. want to align: which of these are micro-release P0s vs next-sprint backlog?
taylor: list?
jamie: 1) streaming suggestion fragments repeated (short prompts) 2) dedicated pool occasional latency spikes under burst 3) minor UX: dropdown flicker after autofill.
anya: customers call #1 the most annoying (demo-visible). #2 is higher risk for enterprise SLAs. #3 is cosmetic and fine to queue.
taylor: technically #1 looks like a chunking/race regression introduced by the new streaming flush change. fix could be small guard or more invasive race-fix. estimate: guard ~4h + canary, proper fix ~3d + tests.
samir: #2 is infra param change (scale-down window tweak). revert globally would be 30m but costs go up; targeted per-customer min replica override is ~2h. longer-term root cause needs 1-2w with telemetry.
jamie: propose rubric: Customers-visible regression that risks demos = remediate quickly (micro-release), infra config regressions that affect paying customers = targeted override + backlog root-cause, purely cosmetic = next sprint.
taylor: agree. For #1, micro-release server guard + client dedupe snippet as stopgap. I'll own server guard.
anya: I'll handle comms and ask customers if they'd accept a short targeted test window.
samir: I'll prepare per-customer override template and a runbook entry for dedicated pools.
ops-bot: ticket created: PL-5201: "postlaunch triage - streaming dedupe micro-release" assigned to taylor. infra ticket PL-5202 created for dedicated-pool overrides.
jamie: timeline & milestones: - Today EOD: deploy guard to canary (10% of pilot traffic) and add dashboard slice dup_chunk_pct - Tomorrow 24h: review metrics and decide rollback vs keep - Grooming: add full race-fix (3d) to next sprint if guard validated.
taylor: guard pseudo: ```js
// suppress repeated chunk text within 400ms
if (chunk.text === lastChunk.text && now - lastEmitMs < 400) return;
emit(chunk);
lastEmitMs = now; lastChunk = chunk;
```
anya: client workaround (shareable): ```js
// client dedupe suggestion-level
let prev=''; function maybeShow(s){ if(s===prev) return; prev=s; show(s); }
```
samir: monitoring: will add dup_chunk_pct and p99_stream_latency to console; set warn at 0.3% and page at 1%. also adding dedicated-pool idle-scaler test to deploy checklist.
jamie: grooming notes: add PL-5203 to backlog for the end-to-end regression harness (streaming prompt bank + automated canaries) and make it a must-have before the next major launch. owner: devex.
ops-bot: micro-release workflow initiated: canary template `redwood deploy canary --from v1.3 --to pilot-cohort --percent 10`
taylor: starting guard PR now, will request infra canary tomorrow AM if green.
anya: I've messaged customers with the plan and offered the client snippet as a workaround during demos.
jamie: decision log (short): #1 -> micro-release (taylor), #2 -> targeted override today (samir), #3 -> backlog next sprint. follow-up checkpoint Tue 09:30. owners added to PL-5201/5202/5203. closing loop here.
(reacts: :white_check_mark: from jamie)
